SELECT
DATE(rr.visit_time) AS date,
DATE_SUB(DATE(rr.visit_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(rr.visit_time)) DAY) AS date,
DATE_FORMAT(rr.visit_time, '%Y-%m-01') AS date,
DATE(rr.visit_time) AS date,
d.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(DISTINCT rr.record_id) AS visitCount, COUNT(DISTINCT rr.record_id) AS totalVisitCount FROM registration_record rr INNER JOIN doctor_schedule ds ON rr.schedule_id = ds.schedule_id INNER JOIN department d ON ds.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE rr.visit_time IS NOT NULL AND rr.status = 2
AND DATE(rr.visit_time) >= #{startDate}
AND DATE(rr.visit_time) <= #{endDate}
AND (d.parent_dept_id = #{deptId} OR ds.dept_id = #{deptId})
GROUP BY
DATE(rr.visit_time), ds.dept_id
DATE_SUB(DATE(rr.visit_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(rr.visit_time)) DAY), ds.dept_id
DATE_FORMAT(rr.visit_time, '%Y-%m-01'), ds.dept_id
DATE(rr.visit_time), ds.dept_id
ORDER BY date DESC, deptId

SELECT t.date AS date, t.typeId AS typeId, t.typeName AS typeName, t.typeRegistration AS typeRegistration, t2.totalRegistration AS totalRegistration FROM ( SELECT
DATE(rr.register_time) AS date,
DATE_SUB(DATE(rr.register_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(rr.register_time)) DAY) AS date,
DATE_FORMAT(rr.register_time, '%Y-%m-01') AS date,
DATE(rr.register_time) AS date,
COALESCE(rt.type_id, 0) AS typeId, COALESCE(rt.type_name, '全部') AS typeName, COUNT(*) AS typeRegistration FROM registration_record rr LEFT JOIN registration_type rt ON rr.type_id = rt.type_id WHERE rr.status IN (0, 1, 2, 5, 6) WHERE rr.status IN (1, 2)
AND DATE(rr.register_time) >= #{startDate}
AND DATE(rr.register_time) <= #{endDate}
AND rr.type_id = #{typeId}
GROUP BY
DATE(rr.register_time)
DATE_SUB(DATE(rr.register_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(rr.register_time)) DAY)
DATE_FORMAT(rr.register_time, '%Y-%m-01')
DATE(rr.register_time)
, rt.type_id, rt.type_name ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT
DATE(rr2.register_time) AS date,
DATE_SUB(DATE(rr2.register_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(rr2.register_time)) DAY) AS date,
DATE_FORMAT(rr2.register_time, '%Y-%m-01') AS date,
DATE(rr2.register_time) AS date,
COUNT(*) AS totalRegistration FROM registration_record rr2 WHERE rr2.status IN (0, 1, 2, 5, 6) WHERE rr2.status IN (1, 2)
AND DATE(rr2.register_time) >= #{startDate}
AND DATE(rr2.register_time) <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY
DATE(rr2.register_time)
DATE_SUB(DATE(rr2.register_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(rr2.register_time)) DAY)
DATE_FORMAT(rr2.register_time, '%Y-%m-01')
DATE(rr2.register_time)
) t2 ON t.date = t2.date ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.typeId

DATE_SUB( DATE_SUB(DATE(rr.visit_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(rr.visit_time)) DAY), INTERVAL #{comparePeriods} WEEK ) AS date,

DATE_SUB(DATE(rr.visit_time), INTERVAL #{comparePeriods} DAY) AS date,
d.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(DISTINCT rr.record_id) AS visitCount, COUNT(DISTINCT rr.record_id) AS totalVisitCount FROM registration_record rr INNER JOIN doctor_schedule ds ON rr.schedule_id = ds.schedule_id INNER JOIN department d ON ds.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE rr.visit_time IS NOT NULL AND rr.status = 2
AND DATE(rr.visit_time) >= DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL #{comparePeriods}
DAY WEEK MONTH DAY
)
AND DATE(rr.visit_time) <= DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL #{comparePeriods}
DAY WEEK MONTH DAY
)
AND (ds.dept_id = #{deptId} OR d.parent_dept_id = #{deptId})
GROUP BY
DATE_SUB(DATE(rr.visit_time), INTERVAL #{comparePeriods} DAY), ds.dept_id
DATE_SUB( DATE_SUB(DATE(rr.visit_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(rr.visit_time)) DAY), INTERVAL #{comparePeriods} WEEK ), ds.dept_id
DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(rr.visit_time, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL #{comparePeriods} MONTH), '%Y-%m-%d' ), ds.dept_id
DATE_SUB(DATE(rr.visit_time), INTERVAL #{comparePeriods} DAY), ds.dept_id

SELECT
DATE(r.apply_time) AS date,
DATE_SUB(DATE(r.apply_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(r.apply_time)) DAY) AS date,
DATE_FORMAT(r.apply_time, '%Y-%m-01') AS date,
DATE(r.apply_time) AS date,
COALESCE(d.dept_id, 0) AS deptId, COALESCE(d.dept_name, r.target_dept_name, '未指定') AS deptName, COALESCE(r.target_type, 'INTERNAL') AS targetType, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN '院内转诊' WHEN r.target_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN '院外转诊' ELSE '未知' END AS targetTypeName, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS applicationCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) END AS approvalRate, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) END AS completionRate FROM hospital_referral r LEFT JOIN department d ON r.target_dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND DATE(r.apply_time) >= #{startDate}
AND DATE(r.apply_time) <= #{endDate}
AND r.target_dept_id = #{deptId}
GROUP BY
DATE(r.apply_time)
DATE_SUB(DATE(r.apply_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(r.apply_time)) DAY)
DATE_FORMAT(r.apply_time, '%Y-%m-01')
DATE(r.apply_time)
, COALESCE(d.dept_id, 0), COALESCE(d.dept_name, r.target_dept_name, '未指定') , COALESCE(r.target_type, 'INTERNAL') , CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN '院内转诊' WHEN r.target_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN '院外转诊' ELSE '未知' END ORDER BY date DESC, deptId, targetType

SELECT
DATE(rr.register_time) AS date,
DATE_SUB(DATE(rr.register_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(rr.register_time)) DAY) AS date,
DATE_FORMAT(rr.register_time, '%Y-%m-01') AS date,
DATE(rr.register_time) AS date,
SUM(rr.actual_price) AS income FROM registration_record rr WHERE rr.status IN (1, 2)
AND DATE(rr.register_time) >= #{startDate}
AND DATE(rr.register_time) <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY
DATE(rr.register_time)
DATE_SUB(DATE(rr.register_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(rr.register_time)) DAY)
DATE_FORMAT(rr.register_time, '%Y-%m-01')
DATE(rr.register_time)
ORDER BY date
